keySentence: No one was brave enough to speak.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The emperor walked. People watched him. They were all scared. No one was brave enough to speak.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The emperor marched proudly through the town streets. All the people gathered to see the new clothes. Everyone could see the emperor was wearing nothing. No one was brave enough to speak the truth out loud. They all pretended to admire the beautiful invisible cloth. Fear of looking foolish kept everyone silent.
facts.Word cards: tricked = 속였다 / emperor = 임금님 / weave = 짜다 / fooled = 속은
